mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Glucose + nitrogen → carbon dioxide + water + energy.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Glucose releases carbon dioxide, water, and energy even when no oxygen is available.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Only green parts of a plant carry out respiration.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Plant respiration: carbon dioxide + water + energy → glucose + oxygen.

intelligence.enrichment: During respiration, glucose is broken down in the presence of oxygen, releasing carbon dioxide, water, and energy; all green and non-green parts of a plant carry out respiration. Glucose + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water + energy. The learner correctly applies this rule: During respiration, glucose is broken down in the presence of oxygen, releasing carbon dioxide, water, and energy; all green and non-green parts of a plant carry out respiration. Plants only photosynthesise; respiration is an animal process or happens only in green leaves.
